step1_figure.schematic_figure: Fig 24.44 and Fig 24.50 (described as Fig 24.51 in text)
step1_figure.circuit_type: Gain-Enhanced Folded-Cascode Op-Amp with Class AB Output Buffer
step1_figure.description: A folded-cascode operational amplifier utilizing a class AB output stage for high drive capability, combined with auxiliary differential amplifiers (gain enhancement) to boost the output resistance of the cascode stages and increase the overall DC open-loop gain.

low_frequency_gain.description: DC open-loop gain of the gain-enhanced op-amp

equation.explanation: The total open-loop gain is the product of the base folded-cascode gain and the gain of the auxiliary enhancement amplifiers.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the auxiliary amplifiers perfectly regulate the cascode drain nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Base OTA gain A_OLDC ~ 500 (54 dB). Aux amp gain A_GE = gm*(ron||rop) ~ 20-30 (26-29 dB). Total gain = 54 + 28 = 82 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain enhancement typically adds 20-40 dB to the base cascode gain depending on transistor sizing and bias currents in the SKY130 process.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB

equation.explanation: Determined by the transconductance of the input differential pair and the compensation capacitor.
equation.assumptions: Assumes a single-pole roll-off dominates up to the unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: With gm ~ 150 uS and Cc = 240 fF, fun = 150e-6 / (2 * pi * 240e-15) = 99.4 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias current of the input pair. The 240fF capacitor sets the bandwidth to around 100 MHz for typical gm values.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Limited by the maximum current the tail current source or output stage can deliver to the load and compensation capacitors.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the output stage can source/sink the full tail current.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a tail current of 20 uA and a load/compensation capacitance of ~1 pF, SR = 20uA / 1pF = 20 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The class AB output stage can provide higher dynamic current, potentially increasing the slew rate beyond the tail current limit, but 20 V/us is a safe typical value.

phase_margin.description: Phase difference from -180 degrees at the unity-gain frequency

equation.explanation: Indicates the stability of the op-amp in closed-loop configuration.
equation.assumptions: Measured in open-loop or inferred from closed-loop AC response.

sky130_expected.calculation: Designed for stability, typically targeting >60 degrees. The text mentions 85 degrees for the OTA and 45 degrees for the buffered version.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 240fF compensation capacitor is sized to push the non-dominant pole past the unity-gain frequency, ensuring adequate phase margin.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, and slew rate of the GE op-amp in a closed-loop inverting configuration.
